Hey 👋. 

I'm Senior Frontend Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications, with a strong focus on React.js and modern eCommerce platforms.

Currently contributing to the next generation of Nespresso.com, developing reusable frontend components with a strong focus on accessibility (A11y), performance, SSR, analytics, multilingual and RTL support.

Experienced in React, Redux, JavaScript, GraphQL, Node.js, design systems, automated testing, SEO and Web Vitals optimization. Comfortable working in distributed international teams and solving complex frontend challenges across large-scale, multi-market products.
